title: Design Studio Selections Goodwill Cap Addition for Build Slip on the Home Purchase Agreement
content:
The goodwill credit cap that the goodwill room of a Design Studio Selections file starts from is raised by the build slip of the Home Purchase Agreement the file serves. The build slip is counted in calendar days from the agreement's contract completion date to its current estimated completion date.

| Build slip | Addition to the goodwill credit cap (USD) |
|---|---|
| More than 30 days | 500.00 |
| 1 to 30 days | 250.00 |
| No build slip | Nothing |

**Records read.** The contract completion date and the current estimated completion date shown on the Home Purchase Agreement.

**Boundary table** (hypothetical dates; contract completion date 2026-09-01)

| Current estimated completion date | Build slip | Addition |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-09-01 | 0 days | Nothing |
| 2026-09-02 | 1 day | 250.00 |
| 2026-10-01 | 30 days | 250.00 |
| 2026-10-02 | 31 days | 500.00 |
| 2026-08-20 | Estimated completion earlier than contract completion: no build slip | Nothing |

**How the addition enters.** The addition is made to the goodwill credit cap itself, before anything else is done with the cap; the builder goodwill credit already granted on the file is subtracted only from the raised cap.

*Hypothetical figure:* a package goodwill credit cap of 250.00 on an agreement with a 45-day build slip is raised to 750.00.
